case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1452 OF 2023 (@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO.2480 OF 2021)
summary: Abuse of process in criminal complaints arising from civil property dispute; FIR quashing sought under Section 482 CrPC; SC/ST Act invoked allegedly maliciously; title disputes resolved civilly against complainant's family; multiple civil suits failed including revenue litigation; police investigation ongoing; abuse of process doctrine applied citing Govind Prasad Kejriwal and Binod Kumar; frivolous criminal allegations to coerce builder; forged document claims rejected; quashing appropriate despite charge sheet not filed.
